# Probes in probes.jsonl whose driver result does not match the recorded
# BigQuery answer yet. Format: <probe id> <reason>. TestDBTGolden fails
# when an unlisted probe diverges and when a listed probe matches, so
# remove a line as soon as its probe is fixed.
#
# BigQuery-only restrictions: BigQuery rejects SQL that GoogleSQL (and
# the go-googlesql analyzer) accepts; the driver returns the GoogleSQL
# answer.
array_agg-2494.h0 BigQuery-only restriction: a top-level result ARRAY with a NULL element is rejected when BigQuery writes the result; belongs in the emulator's output step
array_agg_order_by-5180.h0 BigQuery-only restriction: aggregate ORDER BY ... ASC NULLS LAST is rejected
order_by_nulls_first_last-3197.h0 BigQuery-only restriction: aggregate ORDER BY ... ASC NULLS LAST is rejected
contains_substr-7314.10.direct BigQuery-only restriction: CONTAINS_SUBSTR with a NULL literal search value is rejected at analysis (the column form returns NULL and matches)
contains_substr-7314.10.out BigQuery-only restriction: CONTAINS_SUBSTR with a NULL literal search value is rejected at analysis (the column form returns NULL and matches)
count_distinct-3075.h0 BigQuery-only restriction: COUNT(DISTINCT struct) is rejected
full_outer_join-0303.h1 BigQuery-only restriction: FULL JOIN with an UNNEST array scan is rejected
timestamp_literal-0295.h0 BigQuery-only restriction: a TIMESTAMP literal with 9 fractional digits is rejected (the analyzer accepts nanoseconds and the driver truncates to microseconds)
